name: panel-shell
description: Panel for Claude Code: folder, git with lazygit, context, cache, limits, MCP, subagents, tasks and past sessions

cache.title: Cache duration
cache.description: How long the prompt cache lasts; the panel counts down from the last response. "auto" reads it from promptCacheTtl in your Claude Code settings.

cacheAlert.title: Cache alert
cacheAlert.description: Shows a warning when the cache has 1 minute left (if it lasts 5m) or 5 minutes left (if it lasts 1h), once per response.

color.title: Panel color
color.description: The color of the panel frame and titles.

terminal.title: Terminal for windows
terminal.description: Which terminal opens lazygit, Ver diff and Reanudar. "auto" uses $TERMINAL or the first one installed; inside tmux they always open in a popup.

showLimits.title: Show Límites
showLimits.description: Shows the Límites section on the MAIN tab.

showMcp.title: Show MCP
showMcp.description: Shows the MCP section on the MAIN tab.

showPr.title: Show Pull request
showPr.description: Shows the Pull request section (and its CI checks) on the GIT tab. Needs gh installed and signed in.

showChanges.title: Show Cambios
showChanges.description: Shows the Cambios section on the MAIN tab. The GIT tab always shows Cambios.
